[p-1a2b3c] install the NVIDIA driver 595.104.02 for NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU
Waiting for your decision, found by basalt on 2026-10-04 10:15 UTC

  NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU can use the NVIDIA driver 595.104.02
  instead of nouveau. Only the compute part is installed (CUDA, NVML, OpenCL
  and nvidia-smi), no display packages. If you apply it, the assistant will
  turn on the basalt-nonfree repository, install the NVIDIA driver with the
  signed kernel module for kernel 7.2.8-200.fc44.x86_64 and turn nouveau off
  from the next start.

What will run (exactly these commands, as root, in this order)
  $ dnf -y install basalt-nonfree-release
  $ dnf config-manager setopt basalt-nonfree.enabled=1
  $ dnf -y install --skip-unavailable nvidia-driver-compute kmod-nvidia-open-7.2.8-200.fc44.x86_64
  $ basalt-nvidia arm

Risk: high (the graphics driver changes at the next start; if it does not work
there, the start after it uses nouveau again).
Undo: a snapshot is taken before and after, so you can go back to the state
before the change; a rollback takes effect at the next boot.
  $ sudo basalt snapshots rollback --before p-1a2b3c

Next step
  Restart the computer after applying it. The first start checks the driver
  and goes back to nouveau if it fails, and the snapshot taken before the
  change brings the system back. The driver is proprietary: applying it means
  you accept the NVIDIA Driver License Agreement (basalt drivers license
  nvidia).
  Apply it:   sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c
              (without a prompt: sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c --yes --confirm 94905859)
  Ignore it:  sudo basalt ignore p-1a2b3c

Evidence
  - GPU 0000:01:00.0: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (10de:28a0, 3d), kernel driver now: nouveau
